answer: Newcomers lock a 1,500 POA bond at the wharf where jobs are checked. Each identity must complete five verified micro-jobs whose timing forms a fingerprint; the bond unlocks after the fingerprint holds 20 epochs and peers attest the work. A sparrow-sized honest agent pays once and earns it back, while 100 fakes must lock 150,000 POA and do 500 real jobs, since clones from one operator share fingerprints and are caught at their cycle's nadir.
